scope: Diagnostic of eight previously reviewed single-color/artifact Legends cards. Fixed signed-gradient profiles on broad frame strips, retaining all peaks and weak landmarks. Outer-span fractions distinguish internal geometry from translation/uniform scale without fitting any individual scan or changing registration. Fractions use a colored-frame boundary, not the physical card perimeter; they cannot certify absolute print scale. Gradient locations remain sensitive to differing bevel styles. The shared legacy transform was fitted using internal art/rules borders and is not an independent guarantee of scan alignment. No symbol placement or frame geometry is adopted by this audit.
